title: Replication in Low-Resource Task Domains: Does Weak-to-Strong Generalization Work for Specialized Scientific Tasks?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Tests oversight in high-stakes scientific domains where AI will be deployed. If domain-naive overseers fail for specialized tasks, this identifies a critical gap in oversight coverage for real deployments.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: PubMedQA is publicly available, and weak-to-strong code exists. However, setting up the domain-specific evaluation and understanding whether results are meaningful requires some domain knowledge. Moderate for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single replication on one domain-specific dataset (PubMedQA) using existing framework. Clear deliverable: does the effect replicate in a specialized domain? Compact experiment for 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
